newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Sunday as spinners remained on the sidelines in lacklustre trading, dealers said.
One dealer said rates were likely to open stable on Monday as spinners think prices will drop due to a build-up of about two million bales of unsold stocks at ginneries.
In the kerb market, the rate for NIAB-78 variety fluctuated between 2,375 and 2,400 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and MNH-93 variety between 2,575 and 2,600, the dealer said.
